## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Bourg-en-Bresse, France. It starts at 63 Boulevard de Brou.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Perfect your regal wave and get ready for a real royal experience! The Royal Monastery of Brou is a cluster of monastic buildings, located around an intricate Gothic church and three cloisters. It's considered both a masterpiece and a labor of love.
>
> Explore gorgeous Gothic architecture at your leisure and learn the story of Margaret of Austria, who built this heavenly tomb in the early 16th century to keep her love for her late husband, Philibert II the Handsome, alive. Now that's devotion!

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €12.22. It was rated 4.8 out of 5 from 128 ratings and 92 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
